_comment: Non-secret config for the DYNGW v2 Deal ID console -- web/individual/deal-id-console with its
transport rerouted through the dynamic gateway (ZFS_SB_DEALID_O4_API's DealId entity is read
as ZFS_C_DealIdTP; the OTTK/DTTK pickers and bank filters use the views already registered).
Creating a deal ID needs ZSGSLCTR_DEALID registered as a TABL write target -- until then the
screen reads live and the banner says what is missing.
No password here: it comes from the environment variable named below, falling back to the
gitignored .claude/settings.local.json 'env' block at the repo root.
Port 8777 keeps this server clear of web/individual/ (8765-8772) and of the other dynamic-gw
